molasse.density_source: wet bulk density of the Point 5 marls: 2.51 (SD 0.03, 194 samples, 1997) and 2.50 (17, 2015), GADZ report 7223-2 (HL-LHC Point 5 geotechnical presentation, EDMS 1952965); Fern et al., Tunn. Undergr. Space Technol. 77 (2018) 249 (public, CERN-wide 2.44-2.60 by facies)
molasse.composition: clay 20-60 %, quartz 15-40 %, calcite 20-30 % (Fern et al. 2018), illite 42-59 % of the clay (LHC-K3500-ER-0002), pore water 6.5 % of the dry mass
molasse.lambda_scale: ROOT/Geant4 scale of the CMS material (standard rock 99.5 g/cm2; PDG scale: 96.8-98.0 g/cm2)

simulation_material.name: Molasse_P5
simulation_material.note: representative weak-to-strong marl; use for Geant4 (G4Material by mass fraction)

concrete.note: assumed (CMSSW standard 2.35, reinforced 2.49); no density on record: the CERN civil drawings (2004, LHC-DGS135294002/-003) give strength classes only (invert and pillar concrete C25/30, secondary lining C28/35, fibre-reinforced shotcrete and gunite 30-35 N/mm2), i.e. ordinary normal-weight concrete; the gallery lining is 0.30 m of shotcrete (2004 drawings)

cms.source: CMS simulation geometry CMSSW_20_1_0_pre2 (Run 3), official CMS frame (CMS-I-UR-0281); Geant4 agrees with the ROOT walk to 0.2 lambda_I

magnet_model.cold_mass: winding 262 mm from R 3.160 m + Al 5083 external cylinder 50 mm to R 3.473 m (Kircher et al., IEEE Trans. Appl. Supercond. 10 (2000) 407), as built 222.5 t: 89.5 % Al, 3.9 % Cu, 2.2 % NbTi, 4.4 % G10 (MTB93 annex 9304, EDMS 753430)
magnet_model.tank_and_shields: stainless vacuum-tank shells 60 mm (R 2.970-3.030, 3.740-3.800; CMS Magnet TDR Table 9.2), aluminium thermal shields 5 mm (TDR 17.4.1)
magnet_model.chimney: cryogenic chimney (stainless envelope, thermal shield, 17 pipes) from the CMS magnet drawings CMS-SC-ED-0100/-0107 (restricted; details in the CERN-internal report), over an opening in the outer vacuum-tank shell only (the coil and the inner shell continue); axis at z = +1.471 m (CMSSW)
magnet_model.confirmed: CMS magnet group, 15 Oct 2026: opening only in the outer vacuum-tank shell; cold mass mostly aluminium, ~220 t
magnet_model.cmssw_problem: CMSSW mgnt.xml: copper cold mass (446 t) and the chimney hole (r 0.48 m) cut through every layer

thin_places.where: PX56 mouth (the line climbs the open shaft)

totals.fiducial_volume: not decided; no cut applied (15 Oct 2026)

model: gallery (grendel-geometry): section from the 2015 laser scan (CMS survey team) on the axis and floor of the CERN civil drawings (2004); the UP542 lining of the CERN 3D civil model (PLM ST0116966) moved onto the levels of the 2004 drawings (the 3D civil model's west leg falls 1.91 % instead of 2.22-2.24 %) and mapped onto the section from the 2015 scan; section centre = centroid of that section; PM54 branch: axis from the walls in the 2015 scan, section of the 2004 drawings, modelled 0.30 m lining
